 ATP Vienna Day 3 Predictions Including Frances Tiafoe vs Lorenzo Musetti 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 Six matches are scheduled on Day 3 of the ATP Vienna Open , including the start of second-round action. This article features a blockbuster match between seventh seed Frances Tiafoe and Lorenzo Musetti. As always, we at LWOT will offer predictions for every match on the slate, but which players will advance?
 ATP Vienna Day 3 Predictions
 Brandon Nakashima vs Tallon Griekspoor
 Head-to-Head : Nakashima 1-1 Griekspoor
 This is a rematch of last year’s second round at this event, where Tallon Griekspoor won in two tight sets. Brandon Nakashima will be looking to exact revenge and end Griekspoor’s five-match winning streak. The Dutch player was excellent in Brussels and desperately needed a week like that. However, he will have to deal with a quick turnaround and may be exhausted heading into this match. I’ll go with the American to advance.
 Prediction: Nakashima in 2 
 Jakub Mensik vs Adrian Mannarino
 Head-to-Head : Mensik 0-1 Mannarino
 #8 seed Jakub Mensik cruised to victory against Lukas Neumayer, dropping only four games. Mensik hardly dropped points on his first serve and will be tough to break on these indoor conditions. Adrian Mannarino has been in excellent form lately, but he played six matches in the last nine days and made a slow start in his first-round encounter against Ignacio Buse. Mensik should take advantage.
 Prediction: Mensik in 3 
 Frances Tiafoe vs Lorenzo Musetti
 Head-to-Head : Tiafoe 4-3 Musetti
 Tennis – U.S. Open – Flushing Meadows, New York, United States – September 6, 2026 Frances Tiafoe of the U.S. in action during his round of 16 match against Russia’s Daniil Medvedev IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters/Geoff Burke TPX IMAGES OF THE DAY 
 Frances Tiafoe will play his first match in over 15 days after his close loss to Alejandro Davidovich Fokina in Shanghai. The American has been super consistent this season and will look to end it on a high. Lorenzo Musetti won his third tour-level title and his first since 2022 in Lyon last week. The conditions were ideal for the Italian, and he capitalized brilliantly. Tiafoe has won three of the last four meetings against Musetti and will be much fresher coming into this match.
 Prediction: Tiafoe in 3
